| [CLAIM-592](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-592.md) v3 | Whether a system's own reachable classes ever coincide with what an observer can tell apart depends on the order of the observer's probe costs as well as on the mechanism: the two partitions agree exactly at partitions common to the observer's refinement chain and the system's merge tree, a level of the merge tree can be made to agree under some cost order exactly when it is the common refinement of some set of the available probes, and the cost order decides which of those levels actually appear | The assistant's own proposition, filed on 2026-11-05 at the owner's request after the frontiers of [CLAIM-570](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-570.md) were computed on the degree-4 vertex.
